name: cordon
description: Deterministic Git change envelopes for coding agents: constrain Git-visible paths and change budgets, reject HEAD movement by default, and let independent verifier commands overrule an agent's success claim.
tagline: Limit the blast radius. Verify the result.
highlights: Arms an allow/deny path policy plus file, line, byte, binary and commit budgets.
Audits the Git-visible result independently of anything the agent reports.
Refuses to arm when index flags would hide a tracked file from the audit.
Works with any agent in manual mode, or wraps Claude Code end to end.
quickstart:
cd skills/security/cordon && ./install.sh

cordon run "Fix the parser regression and touch nothing else." \
  --allow "src/parser/**" \
  --allow "tests/parser/**" \
  --verify "python3 -m unittest discover -s tests" \
  --max-files 8 \
  --max-added-lines 400

permissions.filesystem: reads Git-visible repository state; writes only .cordon state and installation files unless the wrapped coding agent changes the target repository
permissions.shell: spawns git, configured verifier commands, and optionally claude
permissions.network: none in arm/check/status/reset; only indirectly through Claude Code in run/resume
permissions.environment: CORDON_PREFIX is read by install/uninstall wrappers; runtime core does not require secrets

security.reviewed_by: Independent review, 2026-08-14: audit-bypass defect C11 found and fixed; live smoke test against Claude Code 2.1.231.

verifications.by: Independent review (Claude Opus 5, on the maintainer's machine)
verifications.method: Ran the full suite plus a live smoke test against Claude Code 2.1.231; attacked the audit with git index flags.
verifications.findings: Defect C11: assume-unchanged/skip-worktree hid a tracked change from the audit. Fixed and covered by six regression tests.
